issues.claim: An endpoint filter can be added to a group created with `MapGroup`, and then it applies to every endpoint in the group.
issues.problem: I believe this is true: RouteGroupBuilder implements IEndpointConventionBuilder, so AddEndpointFilter works on it. But neither fetched excerpt shows it. The min-api-filters excerpt shows AddEndpointFilter only on ControllerActionEndpointConventionBuilder and on route handlers, and the MVC filters excerpt says nothing about groups. The claim is not backed by a cited source, and the generator's own notes flag this.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a link whose text shows AddEndpointFilter on a MapGroup/RouteGroupBuilder, for example https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/aspnet/core/fundamentals/minimal-apis/route-handlers (Route groups section), with linkTitles in both locales. Alternatively, confirm the min-api-filters page shows a group example.

issues.claim: An attribute on the lambda only becomes endpoint metadata ... the attribute code never runs.
issues.problem: I believe this is true. Attributes on a minimal API lambda become endpoint metadata, and the MVC action invoker never sees the endpoint. Neither fetched excerpt states this explicitly, and the generator's notes admit the gap. The answer depends on this claim, so it should rest on a cited source.
issues.suggestedFix: Cite a page that states attributes on route handlers are added as endpoint metadata, such as the route-handlers page of the minimal APIs docs, and add it to links and linkTitles. Or soften the wording to: MVC filters are executed only by the MVC action invoker, which does not handle minimal API endpoints.

issues.claim: MVC filters (authorization, resource, action, exception, result) ... runs only for the endpoints that MVC creates for controllers and Razor Pages.
issues.problem: The cited MVC page says action filters are not supported in Razor Pages, which use page filters instead. Listing all five filter types as running for Razor Pages is imprecise.
issues.suggestedFix: Write: 'It runs only for MVC endpoints (controller actions, and Razor Pages for the filter types they support)'. Mirror the change in the Russian text.

issues.claim: `AddEndpointFilter` also works on a `MapGroup` group, which replaces global filters for a set of endpoints.
issues.problem: 'Replaces global filters' is loose, because a group filter is not application-wide. The explanation also says the filter 'sees the already bound arguments' without noting that filters are skipped on binding failures, which the cited page covers.
issues.suggestedFix: Say 'is the closest analogue of global filters for a set of endpoints'. Optionally add that filters do not run on body-reading failures.
